notes.title: Sales, Sales, Sales! and Announcement on Development
notes.content:
[u][b]Hi everyone! It has been far too long.
[/b][/u]

Let me start off by apologizing for the lack of involvement and interaction in the game dev space. I have been stuck in some fairly aggressive schooling for the past 2 years (CPA Designation…) which has been taking up quite a bit of time. As a result, I have not been able to pump out my goal of 2 games per year, nor have I been able to spend much time, passion and energy in the development of any games in general.

I am happy to say that my final exam in next week (Wednesday to Friday – yes… a 3 day long final exam ☹) and after that, I am pleased to say that I can jump into the world of development once again!!

[u][b]Go forward projects:[/b][/u]

I have recently published Night at the Office (Late 2024) which is more of the traditional TurnVex style game.

My favorite game and my most advanced game is Snafu. Snafu has been an absolute blast to develop and is extremely unique. The reception the game has received is fantastic. Unfortunately, the spotlight out in the frontlines has been limited to the point where it’s fallen into the shadows quite fast. It’s unfortunate, but reality.

My goal for 2025 (and perhaps early 2026) is to develop the next Snafu with a focus on MMO style (without the online component). This approach is a big step up from what I am most comfortable with, but I believe it will be a fun project to work on. Similar to Snafu, it is not the traditional spooky house approach that most horror games are, but rather a unique approach that rarely ever sees the light of day. It may see the same fate as Snafu, falling out of the light quite fast, but it will be a blast to develop!

As always, I want to thank all my followers and those who have supported the journey of developing horror games! I look forward to jumping back into work within the next coming weeks to begin pumping out some spooky games to you all.

With that being said, to commemorate the end (hopefully…) of schooling, finally… All of my games will be 75% off for the week. 

Cheers! And happy gaming, everybody.

Stan. T

notes.title: Night at the Office - New Horror Game - Out This Friday
notes.content:
Happy December, everyone.

Just wanted to let you all know that my next horror game Night at the Office is now officially complete and is ready for launch this Friday the 13th. 

It's been a real pleasure developing Night at the Office, but there definitely were some challenges along the way.

It's been nearly two years since I've released a game, and that is mainly due to both work and school eating up a significant piece of 2023 and 2024, so it was a little difficult getting back into the slow stages of development, especially after releasing Snafu, which I believe to be one of my greatest concoctions. The bar was set quite high, in my opinion...

Nonetheless, Night at the Office takes a traditional approach which I have done in the past, however, with a bit more focus on story and puzzle aspects of the game.

It is always an honour to be able to build these games and push out what lingers in the imagination into a actual playable product; so to that, as always, I hope you all enjoy what Night at the Office has to offer when it releases this coming Friday. And if you could leave a review, providing me with your thoughts on what you enjoyed and/or disliked about the experience, I would greatly appreciate that!

Cheers, everybody and happy gaming.

notes.title: A New Terror - Night at the Office

Holy crap it's been far too long. Almost two whole years since I've release a game, with SNAFU being my last. Unfortunately with school and work taking over a significant portion of my life, development has slowed to a snail's pace. 

With that being said, I am happy to announce that Night at the Office is nearing the final stages of development and is expected to release on December 13th 2024. 

Steam page is up and I would love to hear your initial thoughts on the design, story or any questions you may have.

As always, I thank you all from the bottom of my heart for all the support you've given me throughout these years. These games are always a pleasure to create and I hope to always push out a better product year over year.

Last time, I release Snafu which was a very different concept of a game, but this time, I've returned to the more traditional approach to tell the story of Night at the Office.

cheers, everyone.

Stan. T

notes.title: Snafu is coming out tomorrow - March 8th!
notes.content:
It's finally that time again... Another TurnVex Horror Release!

Let me start off by saying this past month was an absolute nightmare - working a full-time job alongside completing Snafu with a very tight release schedule was absolutely wicked... But nonetheless, the job was done and I am quite happy with the results.

As I've already mentioned several times, Snafu is a very different type of horror game so I am very VERY curious to hear the opinions of you all when the game releases on Wednesday March 8th.

[b]For whoever wants to know:[/b] 

- Snafu has an estimated completion time of approximately 80-minutes. However, this could skyrocket to several hours depending on the level of detail you scower through!

-Snafu features full controller support (For the first time ever!! wow)

- And as always, 3 official endings with a horrible 0.5 bonus ending for those of you who really screw up...

I want to wish you all the best and I hope you give Snafu a chance alongside providing your opinion on the game - that would be greatly appreciated for future titles :)

cheers, everybody.

notes.title: A few months later!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone. I hope you are all doing well on your end.

Just like that, it's been over 2 months since the release of Is Simon There? And just like all my other games, I always like to give you all an update on how the game is doing, some feedback I was given, and what I plan on doing going forward.

[b][u]So how is the game doing?
[/u][/b]
Well, let me start off by saying that Is Simon There? is doing fairly well. Many of you appear to really enjoy what the game has to offer - its simplicity and attention to creating a terrifying environment. Now, of course, the game may have been a little "too" simple, but none the less, I think it turned out well, and I am happy to see that many of you enjoy it, too. 

And the Easter Egg! I am also happy to see that many of you liked the secret little egg in the game. It is definitely a goal of mine to include some sort of egg in every game, so I definitely wont be changing anything there :)

Overall, Is Simon There? is doing fairly well. It is maintaining a fair volume of sales, the reviews are spectacular, and the feedback I am given is also very wonderful. And to that, I want to thank you all for your continued support and sticking by my side when creating these projects. It truly means a lot to me.

[u][b]What's the plan going forward?
[/b][/u]

I recently got a new job in accounting again so I will not have the time to pump out games like I was normally planning (3ish games per year) But I do think I will be able to pump out 1 game a year (as per normal). Time is definitely a tricky thing with work and potentially studying for the CFA... but I am sure I will be able to figure something out.

In terms of new projects, my next game (in the planning stages) will be like my previous game Money Maker (free on Steam). HOWEVER, it will be like Money Maker but with a crap-ton of horror in it. I don't want to say too much in terms of story or game play since it is still super early, but that is kinda what I am steering towards. I am sure 99% of you have no idea what Money Maker is, but I believe adding significant horror to that style of game will be wonderous!

As always, I want to thank you all for sticking around and taking the time to glance over this quick memo. I hope to begin working on my new game soon, and with that said, I hope to begin posting some screenshots in Q4 (one can only hope...).

Cheers, everyone and happy gaming.

Stan. T

notes.title: Is Simon There? is coming tomorrow!
notes.content:
Hello, everybody. I hope you are all doing very well.

I wanted to let you all know that my latest horror Is [u][b]Simon There?[/b][/u] will be releasing tomorrow at 10am PST / 11am Mountain time.

[u][b]Is Simon There?[/b][/u] will be slightly different from some of my more recent releases (i.e. Within Skerry and Inside Depth 6) in that it will focus primarily on creating an atmosphere for the player to dive into. 

[u][b]Is Simon There?[/b][/u] will have fewer [b]required puzzles[/b] (excluding optional puzzles) and fewer "aimless, eventless wandering". My goal is to tell a story while keeping you on the edge of your seat, while anticipating the next event to happen. 

Of course, like my previous games,[u] [b]Is Simon There?[/b][/u] will include 3 endings and 1 Easter Egg/ special ending. I've toned the difficulty of these optional puzzles down a little so that the vast majority of players can experience all the game has to offer without relying on too many guides. 

AND finally, no more getting knocked-out black screens. Nothing but silky smooth progression, a dark story, a neat little Easter Egg, and a hand full of intuitive puzzles to keep you thinking, throughout the 40 minute long journey. 

[u][b]Once again, Is Simon There? will be releasing tomorrow (May 06, 2022). And as always, if you play the game, please leave an honest review. I would love to know what you enjoyed and disliked about the game. [/b][/u]

Once [u][b]Is Simon There?[/b][/u] has been published, I will be spending some time researching new mechanics / systems to implement into new games (i.e. controller support, advanced AI, potential VR, etc)

Cheers, everybody!

Stan. T

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1961300/Is_Simon_There/

notes.title: Weekly Update #2
notes.content:
Hello, everyone.

It's crazy how it's already been over a week. Time flys...

I just wanted to let you all know that development is going very well. Both endings 1 and 2 have been fully completed. The last thing I am working on is Ending 3! Once Ending 3 has been completed, it will be time to do some aggressive testing.

Once again, I am well on schedule for the [u]May 6th release date[/u]. I hope to have Is Simon There? 100% complete by May 2nd so that I can spend the next few days testing.

[u][b]A few outstanding items that need to be completed:[/b][/u]
- Achievements,
- Ending 3,
- Final optional puzzles,
- Final environmental / indoor asset placements,
- Final translations,
- Testing,
- Bug fixes.

We are almost there, everybody! And I am greatly looking forward to seeing your reactions on this one :)

Cheers,

Stan. T

notes.title: Weekly Update 1
notes.content:
Hello everybody. I hope you are all doing excellent!

I just wanted to post a quick update discussing the current state of [b]Is Simon There?[/b]

Firstly, let me start off by saying that development is going [u]very well [/u]and [u]very smoothly[/u]. Everything is going as planned.

Regarding story line, I have finalised the story and am actually quite happy with it. I have also completed developing[b] Ending 1 [/b]of the game - two to go :)

As previously mentioned in another announcement, I said that ending 2 will be quite a different experience in comparison to Ending 1 and 3. However, I shuffled a few things around and found it to be more appropriate to have Ending 3 take that place. As such, endings 1 and 2 will follow the original story line and ending 3 will be some wildcard.

I also added a couple new settings to the game. What do you think about a[b] head bob toggle?[/b] I've received a few complaints in [u]Within Skerry [/u]regarding the head bob motion making some players sick; so I added the ability to disable that bobbing motion. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42237110/5ca71f8481f84ad513eb5c3fbf3c559720f0e2c4.png[/img]

Honestly, at this point in time, I believe I will have [b]Is Simon There?[/b] 100% complete in about 10-12 working days. That should give me ample time to test the game out and make sure no bugs roam the halls.

I think that's all I have for now. Thank you, everybody!

Stan. T
